utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, I’m still hearing three houses confirmed—who’s the point person at the community center, and when do we get the final count?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—good question, Mina. I’m coordinating the repair drive, and I still need to check with the community center for the final count, so give me a nudge if I don’t circle back soon.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, Oren—when exactly are you checking with them, and who there are you confirming with?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: From what I’ve heard, Rosa’s collecting repair needs today and the drive’s filling out with tools and parts, so it sounds like it’s coming together pretty well.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: That’s good to hear, but before we move ahead, can we check with Rosa or Eli for which houses are confirmed and which tools or parts are still missing?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I’d do that—I only know the broad updates, so Rosa or Eli would have the real list of confirmed houses and whatever tools or parts are still needed.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Not yet—I still want confirmation on who’s running intake and whether the drop-off table is by the entrance before we count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, that’s where I’m at too—can someone confirm who’s handling intake and exactly where the drop-off table will be before we rely on it?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Same here—I don’t want us planning around it until someone confirms who’s running intake and whether the drop-off table is actually set up by the entrance.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—I’ve updated it to Sunday at the community center, and I’ll be at the shed from 9 sorting tools and spare parts while you handle intake.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late, Opal—got it, I’ll handle intake Sunday at the community center and swing by the shed at 9 if you need an extra hand sorting.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Dane—that lines up with what I’ve got, and I’ll let you know if the shed setup needs the extra hand at 9.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m still happy to help Sunday, Eli, as long as I’m there outside the 7:30–8:30 and 2:30–3:30 school windows.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works fine, Faye—I’ll place you outside those school windows and send around the Sunday schedule once I’ve got the jobs sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, thanks, Eli—once you send it over, I’ll confirm which Sunday slot fits best around pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: So far I’m hearing about seven volunteers total, and most of the requests are bike tune-ups, small appliance fixes, and a couple of wobbly chairs.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That sounds manageable—put me where I’m most useful, and I can start with intake or help sort the chair and appliance repairs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’d help a lot—could you start on intake and then shift over to the chair and appliance repairs once things settle a bit?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally—let’s keep it broad for now, and I’ll keep telling folks to send any repair needs or spare parts over this afternoon until you confirm the Oak house and timing.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, thanks—I'm still not sure about the Oak house or the exact timing, so broad is probably safest till I double-check.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Sounds good—I’ll keep it general and just point folks toward sending repair needs or spare parts over this afternoon until you’ve got the details nailed down.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, Leo — I’ll be at the shed at 9 and help with tool check and sorting parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, Bo — start with the hand tools when you get there, and set aside anything missing parts for me to check.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll start on the hand tools and pull anything incomplete aside for you.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Cleo—that’s reassuring; I’ll follow up with Oren about the gloves, and we’ll keep Sunday at the community center set while we look for that ladder and a couple of hammers.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Perfect—I’m still tracking a sturdy ladder and a couple of hammers, and if Oren comes through on the gloves we should be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds great, Cleo—thanks for staying on top of the ladder and hammers, and I’ll check with Oren today so we can lock in the gloves for Sunday.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Mara, it’s all coming together nicely—when you bring that box of screws, could you leave it at the shed? We’re getting the tools and spare parts sorted so intake goes quicker by 9.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely—I’ll leave the box of screws at the shed before 9 so you’ve got it for intake.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Mara—thanks a ton; it’s really helping everything fall into place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s set up by the community center, and Eli should have the schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That sounds about right—I’ll still be at the early quiet check-in for a little while, and Rosa’s probably the best one to confirm the full schedule.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Good to know—I’ll keep telling folks it’s at the community center, and I’ll point them to Rosa or Eli for the full schedule this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I only know the basics so far—Saturday at 10 by the community center, and Mina’s still gathering which houses are confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, that helps—I’m still out on errands, but keep me posted as Mina confirms houses, and send me the signup list when Eli has it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I will—I haven’t heard any new house confirmations yet, but I’ll pass them along once Mina does, and I’ll send Eli’s signup list when it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, Ira, I heard the repair drive’s really picking up—folks have been dropping off tools and spare parts, and it sounds like everyone’s keen to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—I’m still out on errands, but send me the signup list when Eli has it and I’ll see where I can help.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, absolutely, Ira—I’ll pass the signup list along as soon as Eli has it, and it sounds like there’ll be plenty to do with all the tools and parts coming in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Opal, I’m still good for the early quiet check-in, and I think it’s mostly the usual small repairs again. If you’ve got the final setup, I’ll follow your lead.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Uli—I’ve still got the repair drive marked as Sunday at the community center, but I’m waiting on final confirmation before I lock anything in.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Alright—just let me know when it’s confirmed, and I’ll be there early for the quiet check-in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Eli — quick update: the repair drive’s been moved to Sunday at the community center; are you still able to help?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Yes, Rosa, I can still help—I’m sorting the signup list now, and I’ll have the updated Sunday schedule ready this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Eli—thank you; once you’ve got the updated Sunday schedule, send it over and I’ll make sure the volunteer list stays in sync.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits secondhand, but it sounds like the repair drive’s coming together — people are dropping off tools, and I heard you’re bringing a box of screws later too.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’s right — I’m dropping off the screws later, and the repair drive starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center if you want to come by.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’s helpful — I’d only heard pieces, so I’ll pass along that it starts at 10 on Saturday at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yep, keep the shed at 9 for now—I’m at the community center at 10, and we’ll shift if Mara says Maple changed.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late—got it, I’ll plan on the shed at 9 unless Mara says otherwise. What still needs fixing there?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly intake and quick triage at the shed, then be ready to shift once we hear where they need hands most.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh—thanks for the reminder, Quinn. I’ve got the gloves, and I still need to check the shed for that ladder and the couple of hammers.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect—if you find the ladder and hammers, send them over to the shed this afternoon, and I’ll keep spreading that the repair drive’s active in case anyone else has spare parts or repair needs.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, this afternoon—I’ll check the shed and bring over the ladder and hammers if they’re there, and I’ve already got the gloves ready.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Gus, the repair drive’s on Sunday at the community center, and I’m still tracking a sturdy ladder, a couple of hammers, and extra work gloves.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can cover the ladder and bring a couple hammers too; I’ll check if I’ve got extra work gloves to spare.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s a huge help, Gus—I'll mark the ladder and hammers down, and let me know if you find those extra gloves too.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’m happy to help with the repair drive, Rey—just tell me what needs me first, and I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Sam. If you can spare any extra work gloves, Cleo wanted those noted down, and Oren was also checking with you about that ladder and the hammers.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can bring the ladder and a few hammers, and I’ll check how many extra work gloves I’ve got so Cleo can note them down.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help Sunday at the community center, as long as it’s outside my school windows—so anytime except about 7:30 to 8:30 and 2:30 to 3:30.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Great—come by at 9 if you can and help with intake and sorting at the spare-parts table; that avoids both school runs.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 9 at the community center works for me, and I can help with intake and sorting at the spare-parts table.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Hana, I’ve been telling folks the repair drive’s set up by the community center, and Eli should have the schedule sorted this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Vik—before we move ahead, can you check with Eli which houses are definitely signed up and whether we still need gloves, trash bags, and a couple of tool kits?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure—I’ll check with Eli which houses are definitely signed up and whether we still need gloves, trash bags, and a couple of tool kits.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Uh, not definitely yet—I still need to confirm who’s organizing it and where we’re meeting before you count on it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Alright, then please check and let me know once you can confirm both who’s organizing it and the meeting spot.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I will—I still haven’t confirmed either one yet, but I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Jules, can you confirm whether it’s still just three houses, and who’s officially in charge of the Saturday drop-off at the community center?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yeah, it’s still three houses confirmed, and the community center’s officially handling the Saturday drop-off while Nell checks with Mara on the last details.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, three houses it is—did Nell get a firm answer from Mara yet, or is the community center still the only confirmed point person?
